disagreements.text: Maria heard the first boarding announcement for her flight. Without a conscious thought, she picked up her small carry-on bag from the floor beside her. Her hand instinctively reached for her passport, already tucked into the front pocket of her jacket. This routine had been ingrained after years of weekly business trips. She stood up, ready to join the queue.

Maria, the veterinary assistant, winced slightly as the small yappy terrier snapped at her. She instinctively pulled her hand back. When the next patient, a placid tabby cat, purred softly against her arm, she smiled. The cat’s gentle presence comforted her instantly, making the earlier irritation vanish.

It was just another end to a familiar cycle.
